mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, balance, total_income, total_expense, version, created_at, updated_at FROM user_points_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, user_id, balance, total_income, total_expense, version, created_at, updated_at FROM user_points_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE user_points_account SET balance = balance + #{amount}, total_income = total_income + #{amount}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND #{amount} > 0

UPDATE user_points_account SET balance = balance - #{amount}, total_expense = total_expense + #{amount}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND #{amount} > 0 AND balance >= #{amount}
mapper.select: SELECT id, transaction_no, user_id, direction, biz_type, biz_id, amount, before_balance, after_balance, status, description, idempotency_key, original_transaction_no, operator_id, created_at FROM points_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, transaction_no, user_id, direction, biz_type, biz_id, amount, before_balance, after_balance, status, description, idempotency_key, original_transaction_no, operator_id, created_at FROM points_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND transaction_no = #{transactionNo} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM points_transaction WHERE original_transaction_no = #{originalTransactionNo} AND biz_type = 'REFUND' AND status = 'SUCCESS'
